device.description: 16-bit 200 kSPS 8-channel simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC with bipolar inputs (+-10 V / +-5 V) on a single supply, parallel / byte / serial read-out
device.note: ads8588s.pdf (SBAS642A) p.4-6 pin configuration and functions, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.13 tCONV (7.15), p.14 serial switching characteristics (7.18), p.16 serial read timing (Figure 5), p.28 oversampling decoding (Table 1), p.33 transfer function (twos complement), p.36-37 pin descriptions (DB15/BYTE SEL, DB14/HBEN, DOUTA/DOUTB), p.42 serial data read (16 SCLKs per channel, 128 on DOUTA)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: levels of the OS2-OS0 pins (no device registers)

pages: p.4-6 pin configuration and functions, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.13 tCONV (7.15), p.14 serial switching characteristics (7.18), p.16 serial read timing (Figure 5), p.28 oversampling decoding (Table 1), p.33 transfer function (twos complement), p.36-37 pin descriptions (DB15/BYTE SEL, DB14/HBEN, DOUTA/DOUTB), p.42 serial data read (16 SCLKs per channel, 128 on DOUTA)
notModeled: only the serial interface is modeled (PAR/SER/BYTE SEL = 1, DB15/BYTE SEL = 0) with DOUTA alone: 8 results of 16 bits each, channel 1 first (128 SCLKs); the PAR/SER/BYTE SEL and BYTE SEL straps are not read

DOUTB (channels 5-8 first, then 1-4) is never driven; parallel (DB[15:0], one channel per RD falling edge) and parallel byte (DB[7:0], HBEN byte order) interfaces not modeled; the DB pins are never driven
a frame may be split into per-channel CS frames (the channel pointer continues across CS frames); the model restarts at channel 1 at each CS fall (all channels carry the same 0 V code)
FRSTDATA output (high while channel 1 is shifted out) not driven

CONVSTB: a conversion begins after the rising edges of both CONVSTA and CONVSTB (channels 5-8 on CONVSTB); the model starts all channels on CONVSTA rising (tie CONVSTA and CONVSTB together, required in oversampling mode)

OS2-OS0 oversampling ratio only sets the conversion time (BUSY high time); the pins are latched at BUSY falling for the next conversion in the device, read continuously by the model; OS = 111 (invalid) uses the longest time
reads during a conversion return the previous sample in the device (same 0 V code)
STBY / RANGE power-down modes (standby, shutdown), REFSEL, RANGE input range: not modeled
RESET also needed after power-up (the model starts reset); minimum 50 ns pulse
SPI mode: SCLK idles high in Figure 5; MSB driven at CS fall, later bits on SCLK rising, read on SCLK falling: modeled as mode 2
analog inputs, PGA, low-pass filter, reference, acquisition time
conversion times are the datasheet maxima per OS ratio (no OS 3.9 us ... OS 64 311 us); tCYC limits (5 / 9.7 / 15 us) are not enforced
variants: ADS8588S (200 kSPS, ads8588s.pdf) is the slower sibling of the ADS8588H (500 kSPS, own spec file, own datasheet); same pinout and serial read-out, longer conversion times. Pin-compatible family: ADS8598H/S 18-bit, ADS8588H/S 16-bit, ADS8586S 6 channels, ADS8584S 4 channels, ADS8578S 14-bit
